quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 绑定 8:15 与 shuttle leaves 事件

major_issues: Front asks for a timing click, but the product contract does not keep timing click as a core interaction.
The card renders as flip after legacy downcast, so the interaction and answer behavior are not aligned.
The useful learning target is binding eight-fifteen to shuttle leaves, not click timing.

batch_review.box_progression: The transcripts can support 时间 training, but the existing sample does not consistently make time-event binding auto-checkable or metadata-complete.
repetition_or_gap_risks: Only the second existing card is close to an auto-checkable time-detail task.
The first card is a generic flip prompt; the third asks for unsupported timing-click behavior.
All three cards need explicit candidate metadata and source boundaries before user review.
batch_review.next_step: Do not ask for approval on the existing sample. Draft a revised 3-card candidate sample focused on deadline, reschedule, and event-time binding.
